summary: Display-time translation of profile fields (name/about/job/education/language) tested end-to-end. Backend: /api/translate/batch name mode transliterates (Мария->Maria en, মারিয়া bn, मारिया hi, মাৰিয়া as; Alex->Алекс ru; Любовь->Lyubov in name mode vs 'Love' in text mode, separately cached), default text mode translates, invalid mode 422, unauthenticated 401/403. /api/i18n/bn|as|hi return full bundles (lang matches, no error, 288/288 native-script); cold new language (ta) built in 8.7s. Chat translation regression OK (gpt-4.1-mini). Frontend: own profile edit inputs show translated values in en and bn, focus shows original, blur without change leaves DB untouched, editing job saves original ('Учитель музыки') and shows translation ('Music teacher') after blur; preview view-name/view-about translated; other profile, Home cards + greeting, Discover cards, chats list, chat room header all transliterated in bn/en; Settings switch to Russian translates English profile (Al Amin Dewan -> Ал Амин Деуан, 'I am a student' -> 'Я студент'); /premium fully translated in en and ru (only intentional recipient name 'Ал Амин Д.' stays Cyrillic).
